attributions.surface_quote: scientism consigns all that has to do with the question of the meaning of life to the realm of the irrational or imaginary.

canonical_statement: Technical possibility is equated with moral admissibility by scientism.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: if something is technically possible it is therefore morally admissible.

canonical_statement: Pragmatism excludes theoretical considerations and ethical principles from decision-making.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: pragmatism, an attitude of mind which, in making its choices, precludes theoretical considerations or judgements based on ethical principles.

canonical_statement: Democracy can be based on majority rule without reference to unchanging values.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: a concept of democracy which is not grounded upon any reference to unchanging values

canonical_statement: A one-dimensional view of humanity excludes existential analysis.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: a one-dimensional vision of the human being, a vision which excludes the great ethical dilemmas and the existential analyses

canonical_statement: Nihilism denies all foundations and objective truth.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: the nihilist interpretation, which is at once the denial of all foundations and the negation of all objective truth.

canonical_statement: Neglecting one's being leads to a loss of objective truth and human dignity.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: neglect of being inevitably leads to losing touch with objective truth

canonical_statement: Truth and freedom are interdependent; their separation leads to misery.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: Truth and freedom either go together hand in hand or together they perish

canonical_statement: The principle of immanence has led to questioning previously accepted claims.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: affirmation of the principle of immanence... has provoked a radical requestioning of claims

canonical_statement: Some postmodern thought posits that the era of certainty is over, requiring humans to accept a meaningless, provisional existence.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: the time of certainties is irrevocably past... live in a horizon of total absence of meaning

canonical_statement: The experience of evil can lead to the collapse of rationalist optimism.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: The terrible experience of evil... has ensured the collapse of rationalist optimism

canonical_statement: Authentic freedom is conditioned by an honest relationship with truth.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: honest relationship with truth as a condition for authentic freedom

canonical_statement: Illusory or superficial freedom is a failure to embrace the whole truth about humanity and the world.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: avoid every kind of illusory freedom, every superficial freedom

canonical_statement: Freedom is rooted in the soul, heart, and conscience of an individual.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: in man's soul, his heart and his conscience

canonical_statement: The historical progression of human events is characterized by the advancement of reason, leading to increased happiness and freedom.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: viewed history as the triumphant progress of reason, the source of all happiness and freedom

canonical_statement: A belief in scientific and technical progress can foster the illusion that humanity can achieve complete self-determination and control over its destiny.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: illusion that, thanks to scientific and technical progress, man and woman may live as a demiurge

canonical_statement: Theology's function is to interpret and convey the content of faith in a manner comprehensible to the prevailing cultural context of its time.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: theology has always had to respond in different historical moments to the demands of different cultures

canonical_statement: The ultimate object of theological inquiry is divine truth and God's salvific plan as revealed through Jesus Christ.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: the proper object of their enquiry is “the Truth which is the living God and his plan for salvation

canonical_statement: The pursuit of universally valid truth is a prerequisite for genuine dialogue and the overcoming of divisions between individuals.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: To believe it possible to know a universally valid truth is in no way to encourage intolerance

canonical_statement: The Spirit of Truth guides consciousness into complete understanding of reality.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: the Spirit of truth... will guide you into all the truth

canonical_statement: The full apprehension of reality is contingent upon the historical events of Christ's life, death, and resurrection.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: connected with everything that Christ 'did and taught'

canonical_statement: Theological understanding is centered on the contemplation of the divine mystery, particularly the Incarnation, Death, Resurrection, and Ascension of God.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: The very heart of theological enquiry will thus be the contemplation of the mystery of the Triune God.

canonical_statement: Divine truth is communicated through human language and sacred texts, reflecting a condescension that mirrors the Incarnation.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: Human language thus embodies the language of God, who communicates his own truth with that wonderful “condescension”.

canonical_statement: The truth of sacred texts transcends mere historical events, residing in their salvific meaning within the history of salvation.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: the truth of the events which these texts relate lies rather in the meaning they have in and for the history of salvation.

canonical_statement: Dogmatic statements formulate unchanging, ultimate truth, despite historical and cultural conditioning of their expression.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: dogmatic statements, while reflecting at times the culture of the period in which they were defined, formulate an unchanging and ultimate truth.

canonical_statement: Faith is the means by which humans enter into the reality of revealed mystery, guided by the Spirit of truth.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: it is faith that adequately introduces man into the reality of the revealed mystery.

canonical_statement: Dogmatic formulas, when expressed with greater clarity or development, retain their true and constant meaning.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: meaning of dogmatic formulas remains ever true and constant

canonical_statement: Dogmatic formulas signify truth in a determinate way, not merely as changeable approximations.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: dogmatic formulas cannot signify the truth in a determinate way

canonical_statement: Doctrinal terms developed by Catholic teachers over centuries are based on true knowledge of created things.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: terms developed by Catholic teachers are based on true knowledge

canonical_statement: Reality possesses ontological, causal, and communicative structures that are knowable through the philosophy of being.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: views reality in its ontological, causal and communicative structures

canonical_statement: The philosophy of being is grounded in the act of being itself, enabling comprehensive openness to all of reality.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: based upon the very act of being itself, which allows a full and comprehensive openness

canonical_statement: A crisis of truth leads to disorientation of the ethical conscience and the loss of universal moral standards.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: many of the problems of the contemporary world stem from a crisis of truth

canonical_statement: Conscience, in its fundamental reality, is the intellect's application of universal good to specific situations, not an independent source of moral criteria.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: Conscience is no longer considered in its prime reality as an act of a person's intelligence

canonical_statement: Ethical reasoning requires a foundation in the truth of the good, presupposing a metaphysics of the good and philosophical anthropology.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: requires a philosophical ethics which looks to the truth of the good

canonical_statement: Human nature possesses an innate capacity to know truth and a desire for ultimate meaning.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: inscribed by God in human nature, the human and humanizing meaning of God's word also emerges more clearly.

canonical_statement: Theology is enriched by communal reflection and the tradition of the People of God, not just individual thought.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: the wealth of a communal reflection. For by its very nature, theology is sustained in the search for truth by its ecclesial context

canonical_statement: Philosophy serves as a medium for understanding and dialogue with individuals of differing faiths.

attributions.chapter: CHAPTER VII - CURRENT REQUIREMENTS AND TASKS
attributions.surface_quote: Philosophical thought is often the only ground for understanding and dialogue with those who do not share our faith.
